findings.scope: Viewer-level selection review, not a reproduced multiplayer defect
findings.observation: Both selected rendering methods read ClientPlayerDataManager.get().getSkill. Model trim additionally requires the rendered entity to be a Player. Texture trim checks getLevel(true)==1000 without that entity-type gate.
acceptance_matrix: Remote wearer and local viewer with opposite skill levels
Non-player armor stand or other supported entity while the viewer is at 1000
Resource reload, reconnect and switching the viewed entity
findings.limit: The intended cosmetic ownership policy and actual in-game result must be verified before changing behavior.

limits: The stock setLevel method clamps its stored level to 0..1000; ==1000 versus >=1000 is not by itself evidence of a stock reachable mismatch
Six registered skill helmets are covered; other dormant model classes are not presented as obtainable items
Fullbright reference shading is an approximation; geometry and fullbright cube flags are preserved
